cursor.description: Opaque page boundary. A numeric ticket id is still accepted. A newly issued cursor also carries the update stamp it was issued against.

fields.description: Extra record fields to include. `description` and `history` are omitted unless named here. Unrecognised names are ignored.

parentId.description: Parent issue by key (`CODE-123`) or numeric ticket id. JSON `null` clears the filter.

parent_id.description: Parent issue by key (`CODE-123`) or numeric ticket id. JSON `null` clears the filter.

project.description: Project-group label name. This is not the Kanban project id.

state.description: Filter by Kanban workflow state name: Draft, Parked, Blocked, Scheduled, Ready, Active, In Review, Approved, Landing, Done, Cancelled, Superseded, or Duplicate. Also accepts workflow types: backlog, unstarted, started, completed, canceled, and duplicate; a type matches every state of that type. Matching is case-insensitive and input is not trimmed. Unknown values such as Todo are refused. Omit or send null for all states.

team.description: Kanban project code, the Linear team. For example `CORE`.
